name: Calendar & Mail
description: Your calendar and email, through the Mac's own Calendar and Mail apps, with every account added there. Hob writes email drafts; you send them.
author: Hob
prompt: For the user's calendar use calendar_events and calendar_add_event; for email use mail_search, mail_read and mail_draft (drafts only: the user sends); for Reminders use reminders_list, reminder_add (with an alert, repeat, priority or link when asked), reminder_update (also to tick one off) and reminder_delete (they need the id reminders_list shows; list first; the user is asked before each change; macOS asks for Reminders access the first time); for the Notes app use notes_search, notes_read, note_add, note_update (prefer append, which keeps the note's formatting) and note_delete (it goes to Recently Deleted), with the ids notes_search shows (the user is asked before each change; macOS asks for permission to control Notes the first time). When you mention a note, give its link from the tool result as a markdown link, like [Trip ideas](hob-note://…): a click opens it in Notes. They use the calendar and email the user connected (a Google or Microsoft account, or the Mac's Calendar and Mail apps): don't ask the user to set up a connector for Google Calendar, Gmail or Outlook. If a tool says nothing is connected, tell the user how to connect.
